title: The best AI phone answering for vacation rentals (2026)
summary: AI phone answering for vacation rentals compared: caller matching, property knowledge, handoff rules, call records and price, plus answering services.
body_markdown:
**The best AI phone answering for vacation rentals picks up every call, knows which guest is calling and which property they're in, answers routine questions from your own property knowledge, and hands the call to a person the moment it should. Generic AI receptionists can do the first part. What vacation rentals need is the second: the call has to land in the same place as the guest's messages, with the reservation attached, so nobody asks the guest to repeat themselves.**


We make ProhostAI, which offers an AI phone line, so we're on this list. We've described each option fairly and said who it's best for, including when a human answering service is the better choice. Prices were checked on vendor sites in November 2026; where a price isn't published, we say so.


## Key takeaways


- **Guests call when it's urgent.** Lockouts, late arrivals, no hot water. Those calls come at night and on weekends, which is exactly when nobody wants to pick up.
- **Context is the whole game.** The AI should match the caller to a reservation and answer from that property's details: door instructions, parking, Wi-Fi, checkout time.
- **Handoff rules matter more than the voice.** Decide which calls go straight to a person (safety, damage, owners, anything the AI isn't sure about) and make sure the tool can follow those rules.
- **Every call should leave a record.** A transcript and summary next to the guest's messages means your team picks up where the call left off.
- **Price models differ.** AI tools charge by plan or minutes; human answering services charge per minute or per call and cost much more at volume.


## What to look for


1. **Caller match:** does it recognize the guest from their phone number and pull up the reservation?
2. **Property knowledge:** does it answer from the same knowledge your messaging uses, or from a separate script you have to maintain?
3. **Handoff:** can you set rules for when to transfer, and to whom, by time of day or topic?
4. **Follow-up:** can it text the guest a link or instructions after the call?
5. **Record:** is every call recorded, transcribed and summarized where your team already works?
6. **Your number:** can you keep the number guests already have, or get a new local or toll-free one?

## 1. ProhostAI AI Phone


**Best for:** hosts and property managers who want phone calls handled with the same knowledge and inbox as their guest messages.


ProhostAI's AI Phone gives you a phone line your AI receptionist answers. You can get a new local or toll-free number, or port the number your guests already know. You pick the voice, the greeting and the answer mode. When a guest calls, ProhostAI matches the caller to their conversation and reservation, answers from your property knowledge, can follow up by text, and hands the call to a teammate or an AI employee according to rules you set.


After every call, the recording, transcript, summary and key points land in the guest's conversation, next to their Airbnb or PMS messages. Your team can also place outbound calls from the inbox and choose which number to call from.


- **Strengths:** one knowledge base for calls and messages; the full history in one thread; works with Airbnb directly or with Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Lodgify, Smoobu and Beds24.
- **Trade-offs:** AI Phone is billed separately from the core plan, and calls use a shared pool of credits, so very high call volume needs a larger plan.
- **Pricing:** plans start at $30 per month, with one pool of credits shared between calls and texts. See[AI Phone](https://prohost.ai/ai-phone) and[plans](https://prohost.ai/plans) .


## 2. Conduit


**Best for:** large operators who want one AI agent platform across phone, messaging and tasks from one vendor.


Conduit is an AI agent platform for hospitality that covers phone alongside Airbnb, Vrbo, WhatsApp, SMS and email. Its agents answer guests, create tasks from what they report, and send work orders to cleaners.


- **Strengths:** voice is part of the same agent that handles messages and tasks.
- **Trade-offs:** priced per unit, so a large portfolio pays for voice on every unit; cleaning and maintenance dispatch needs the $48 Full Suite.
- **Pricing:** Conduit publishes per-unit plans: Messaging at $18, Guest at $30 (adds upsells) and Full Suite at $48 (adds cleaning and maintenance dispatch) per unit per month, plus a Startup plan at $899 a month for up to 25 units (checked November 2026). Voice AI is included from the Messaging plan.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Conduit AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/conduit) .


## 3. SendSquared


**Best for:** vacation rental managers already using SendSquared for marketing and guest CRM.


SendSquared is a marketing and CRM platform built for vacation rental companies that has added AI voice for inbound and outbound calls, connected to the major PMSs used by professional managers.


- **Strengths:** built for the vacation rental industry; ties calls to marketing and guest data.
- **Trade-offs:** the most value if you also use the rest of its platform; pricing isn't published.


## 4. Human answering services


**Best for:** high-value calls where a human voice matters more than cost, such as owner relations or luxury reservations sales.


Services like Ruby and Smith.ai provide live receptionists who answer in your company's name, follow a script, take messages and transfer calls. Smith.ai also offers an AI receptionist alongside its human agents.


- **Strengths:** a real person on every call; good at sales and sensitive conversations.
- **Trade-offs:** they only know what's in your script, they don't see your reservations, and costs rise with every minute. Notes arrive by email or in their own portal, not in your guest inbox.
- **Pricing:** per minute or per call, on plans listed on their sites.


A common setup is AI for guest calls and a human service, or your own team, for owner and sales calls. ProhostAI's handoff rules can route those calls to the right person.


## 5. General AI receptionists


**Best for:** businesses whose callers aren't guests with a reservation.


Many horizontal AI receptionist tools answer calls, take messages and book appointments for any small business. They're inexpensive and quick to set up, but they don't know your reservations or properties unless you build that connection yourself, and calls end up in a separate tool from your guest messages.


## How to set up AI phone answering well


1. **Start with your top 10 call reasons.** Check last month's calls or ask your team. For most hosts it's access, parking, Wi-Fi, late arrival, early check-in and something broken.
2. **Make sure the AI knows each property.** If your messaging AI already answers these questions well, your phone AI should use the same knowledge.
3. **Write your handoff rules before going live.** Safety and damage go to a person immediately. Owners and vendors go to the right teammate. Anything uncertain gets a callback.
4. **Keep your number.** Porting the number guests already have avoids confusion; keep your old service running until the port completes.
5. **Read the first week of transcripts.** Fix the answers that missed, the same way you'd coach a new teammate.


## Frequently asked questions


**Can AI answer phone calls for my Airbnb or vacation rental?**
Yes. An AI phone line answers calls, matches the caller to their reservation, answers common questions from your property information, and transfers to a person when needed. ProhostAI's AI Phone also puts every call's transcript and summary into the guest's conversation.


**Will guests be frustrated talking to an AI on the phone?**
Mostly they're frustrated by voicemail. A good AI answers instantly, solves routine questions in under a minute, and transfers anything it can't handle. Set clear handoff rules so urgent problems reach a person.


**Can I keep my existing phone number?**
With ProhostAI you can port your current number or get a new local or toll-free one. Keep your current service active until the transfer completes.


**How much does AI phone answering cost for vacation rentals?**
ProhostAI's AI Phone plans start at $30 per month, with credits shared between calls and texts. Human answering services usually charge per minute or per call, which costs more as call volume grows.


**What's the difference between an AI receptionist and an answering service?**
An answering service uses live people who follow your script. An AI receptionist answers instantly at any hour and, when it's connected to your reservations, knows who's calling and which property they're in. Many managers use both: AI for guests, people for owners and sales.
